meta.title: Kickot | Bot for Kick Platform
meta.desc: Kickot is a powerful chatbot for Kick platform. Commands, moderation, watchtime, leaderboard and mini games.

hero.titleRest: for KICK that works while you stream
hero.subtitle: Powerful chatbot for Kick platform with custom commands, auto moderation, watchtime system, mini-games and leaderboard. In Serbian and English.
hero.note: Free plan available. No credit card required.
hero.previewChatresponse: ❤️ Love Calculator: @user + @kickot = 100% | Comment: Perfect match, pure chemistry and eternal love! ❤️🔥

features.label: FUNCTIONALITIES
features.subtitle: Kickot comes with a powerful set of modules that ensure complete control over your stream, from moderation to chatbot economy.

cmd.title: Custom Commands
cmd.desc: Define custom commands with custom responses, cooldowns and permissions for ranks. System works in real-time.

mod.title: Advanced Moderation
mod.desc: Protection against capital letters (Caps), links, emojis, symbols, banned words and spam with flexible penalty measures.

wt.title: Watchtime & Leaderboard
wt.desc: Automatic tracking of watch time and chat messages. Monthly ranking list with CSV export and automatic archiving.

eco.title: Ranking System & Coins
eco.desc: Customize currency name, set rewards for watching, subscriptions and KICK donations. Include reward shop and casino games.

games.title: Mini-games & Marriages
games.desc: Entertain chat with !duel, !roll, !iq, !rulet, or start love system with matchmaking and compatibility tracking.

song.title: Song Request (YouTube Music)
song.desc: Allow viewers to request songs from YouTube via chat and manage audio playback directly from the dashboard.

cmds.label: Commands
cmds.subtitle: Click on a command to see how it responds in chat in real-time.

desc.topwt: Top list by stream watch time
desc.rank: Check your rank on the leaderboard
desc.duel: Challenge another user to a duel

pricing.title: Choose your power package
pricing.subtitle: Simple. Clear. No hidden costs.
